purpose: Determine whether an exact deep-AQUAL spacelike kinetic branch can cross X=0 into a nondegenerate timelike branch, and quantify what a smooth positive-floor regulator repairs and sacrifices without claiming a healthy complete theory.

branch_and_scope_contract.invariant: X=-g^munu d_mu(phi)d_nu(phi)/2; quasistatic gradients have X<0 and homogeneous timelike evolution has X>0
branch_and_scope_contract.restricted_background: chi=0 so C=P_X, C_X=P_XX, K=P_X+2X P_XX, K_ADM=K on homogeneous slices, and det(A_phi^mu_nu)=C^3 K
branch_and_scope_contract.deep_aqual_branch: For -epsilon<X<0, exact deep-AQUAL scaling is P_X=A(-X)^p with A>0 and p=1/2; the package also derives the generic p>0 result.
branch_and_scope_contract.health_target: A transition interval containing X=0 would need finite differentiable coefficients and strict positive lower bounds on C, K, and the ADM Legendre coefficient.
branch_and_scope_contract.scope_limit: The result concerns the scalar external-metric principal and Legendre block near X=0. It does not include metric constraints, matter characteristics, nonlinear completion, or observations.

exact_transition_theorem.derivatives: For X<0, P_X=A(-X)^p and P_XX=-A p(-X)^(p-1).
exact_transition_theorem.limit: For every p>0, C, K, K_ADM on the homogeneous transition, and det(A_phi^mu_nu) tend to zero as X approaches 0 from below.
exact_transition_theorem.regularity: For 0<p<1, P_XX diverges as X approaches 0 from below; in particular exact p=1/2 deep-AQUAL is not a C2 kinetic function across X=0.
exact_transition_theorem.conditional_no_go: No kinetic function that remains exact deep-AQUAL arbitrarily close to X=0 can also provide a C2, uniformly nondegenerate scalar principal/Legendre transition through X=0.
exact_transition_theorem.escape_conditions: Avoidance requires ending the exact law at finite negative X, adding a positive kinetic floor, changing variables/fields, avoiding the X=0 crossing, or accepting degeneracy/strong-coupling risk.

regulated_example_contract.spacelike_branch: For X<=0, P_X=sqrt(mu^2-A^2 X), so C>0, K=(mu^2-2A^2 X)/sqrt(mu^2-A^2 X)>0, and P(0)=0 may be set by P=2[mu^3-(mu^2-A^2 X)^(3/2)]/(3A^2).
regulated_example_contract.timelike_extension: For X>=0, P_X=mu/sqrt(1+A^2 X/mu^2), which matches P_X and P_XX at X=0 and gives K=mu/(1+A^2 X/mu^2)^(3/2)>0 for every finite X.
regulated_example_contract.transition: At X=0, C=K=K_ADM=mu and the scalar Legendre/principal block is nondegenerate.
regulated_example_contract.aqual_tradeoff: On X<0 the relative C departure from A sqrt(-X) is sqrt(1+1/t)-1; exact deep-AQUAL is recovered only asymptotically for t>>1, while t<<1 has the kinetic floor C approximately mu.
regulated_example_contract.spacelike_speed: K/C=(1+2t)/(1+t), interpolating from 1 at the regulated transition to 2 in the deep-AQUAL regime.
regulated_example_contract.timelike_cone_warning: For X>0, c_phi^2=C/K=1+A^2 X/mu^2>1 relative to the Einstein and purely conformal matter/photon cone.
regulated_example_contract.uniformity_warning: Although C and K are positive at every finite X, both tend to zero as X approaches positive infinity, so no global positive lower bound exists on an unbounded timelike domain.
regulated_example_contract.claim_limit: This is a machine-checked counterexample to transition degeneracy after relaxing exact low-gradient AQUAL, not a promoted kinetic function or a causal, cutoff-safe, source-supported theory.

machine_check_contract.symbolic_zero_rule: sympy.simplify(actual-expected)==0 or an exact one-sided limit

remaining_obligations: derive the phenomenologically required P_X from the frozen shared formula and source map rather than selecting a regulator by hand
choose and preregister a finite realized X domain and prove uniform coefficient and cutoff margins on every source-supported background
resolve or bound the regulated timelike cone widening relative to the one universal matter/photon metric
restore the chi gate, metric constraints, matter characteristics, potentials, boundary flux, and nonlinear Hamiltonian lower bound
solve Solar, galaxy, cluster, and cosmological backgrounds with one parameter set before any observational scoring
